rules: every paid outcome, including ordinary loss, claims exactly one pre-generated complete-Round member
one member contains all ordered Steps for that Round
empty or unavailable pool returns HTTP 503 without debit, History or active Round creation
runtime fixtures, runtime random construction and scripted rotation are forbidden

failureContract.corruptMember: reject before debit and do not expose a partial Round
failureContract.rulesHashMismatch: Compile-time shared hash and isolated empirical namespace; member stores facts without a per-member rules hash.

integerMultiplierPolicy: exact payout/paidBet; fractional candidates excluded from Loader pools; never floor payout into a different bucket
outcomeSelection: SecureRandom chooses loss/win, then uniformly chooses an existing exact integer payout multiplier; atomically LPOP one member; no generation or fixture fallback
legacyPools: not deleted or consumed by new namespace
